title: Privacy Policy
introText: The Linglify educational platform (hereinafter referred to as the "Platform", "we", "us") takes your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you use our platform. By using Linglify, you agree to the terms described in this Policy.
collectPersonalItems: Information from Google profile (for OAuth authorization)
useItems: Analyze platform usage and improve functionality
Provide technical support and respond to requests
Comply with legal requirements and obligations
protectIntro: We use modern technologies to protect your data:
rightsIntro: Under data protection laws, you have the right to:
rightsItems: Access: request a copy of your data
Rectification: update or correct inaccurate information
Deletion: request deletion of your account and data
Restriction: request temporary limitation of processing
Portability: receive data in a structured format
Withdraw consent: revoke consent at any time
Objection: object to certain types of processing
rightsContact: To exercise these rights, contact us at
cookiesIntro: We use cookies to improve the platform. Cookies are divided into:
cookiesItems: Essential: for authentication and core functionality
Functional: to remember preferences and settings
cookiesNote: You can manage cookies in your browser settings, but disabling some cookies may limit platform functionality.
thirdPartyIntro: We may share data with the following third parties:
thirdPartyNote: All partners follow privacy standards and use data only to provide Linglify services.
retentionText: We store your data for as long as your account exists. After account deletion, personal data is deleted within 30 days, except information that must be retained by law (for example, transaction data).
changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will notify you of significant changes by email or via a platform notice. We recommend checking this page periodically for updates.
contactsIntro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us:
